en.title: AFSA online CIS misses other Amendments No. 7 changes: Venture Capital Fund (2.4(b)(iii)), 7.6(b) "Associates", and rule 1.6 without text
en.summary: The AFSA online CIS includes many changes made by Amendments No. 7 (in force 1 January 2025), but not these: (1) 2.4(b)(iii) still describes a Venture Capital Fund as "an Exempt Fund and a Domestic Fund" that invests "in the equity share capital" of unlisted businesses; Amendments No. 7 deleted "and a Domestic Fund" and replaced "equity share capital" with "Securities and Units", while the online text already shows the feeder route added by the same amendment; (2) 7.6(b) still says "Associates" where Amendments No. 7 put "Related Parties"; (3) rule 1.6 (when a Fund invests in Digital Assets indirectly), inserted by Amendments No. 7, has a heading but no text under it.
en.correction: Please apply Amendments No. 7 to rules 2.4(b)(iii), 7.6(b) and 1.6 in the online CIS.
